doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His real name Jean and his April 29, 1922 birth
summary: Toots gives his four first names and birth date, which he shares with Duke Ellington.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yes, my real name is Jean.
And in Belgium… I was born in Belgium. Jean-Baptiste Frédéric Isidor. Four first names. And then Thielemans.
And in French-speaking Belgium, they will pronounce it Thielemans. But I was born April 29, 1922.
That’s Duke Ellington’s birthday, as well.
Yeah, same day. Just a few years later. [laughs]
